name: bench-budget
cmd: apt-get install -y -qq clang >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq clang >/dev/null); echo "$(clang --version | head -1); bun $(bun --version); $(lean --version)"; nproc; bun compare/bench/run.ts budget 2>&1
